follow-up time: The study duration was 1.5 years, from April 2021 to September 2022.
cohort: 100 pregnant women experiencing antepartum hemorrhage at a tertiary care hospital
finding: Antepartum hemorrhage was associated with significant maternal and fetal morbidity, including high rates of cesarean section, blood transfusion, prematurity, low birth weight, and stillbirth.
gest_age: The study included women across a range of gestational ages, with the most common presentation at 34-36+6 weeks (34%) and 37-39+6 weeks (28%).
birth_weight: Low birth weight was observed in 81% of infants.
